description: This file defines the 'Log' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, providing functionalities to view, download, and clear logs related to system errors.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Controller class for managing system log files, including viewing, downloading, and clearing logs, within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the log files list, including breadcrumbs, error messages, and rendering the 'tool/log' view.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Allows downloading of a specific log file specified by filename, setting appropriate headers for file transfer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the specified log file, reinitializing it if it doesn't exist, with permission checks.
